title: kmd-web performance and bundle size budgets
description: Warning and failure thresholds for benchmark and bundle size measurements. Update with rationale — do NOT silently replace.

version.description: Budget version. Increment on every intentional update.

measuredAt.description: Date when the baseline was measured (ISO 8601 date).

parseTime.description: Median parse time (render()) budgets in milliseconds per fixture.

repeatedUpdate.description: Repeated update (10 sequential renders) median time in ms.

memory.description: Heap delta after rendering large document in KB.

bundle.description: Bundle size budgets per package in KB. rawWarn/rawFail for minified, gzipWarn/gzipFail for gzipped.

bundleBaseline.description: Aggregate baseline bundle size (excluding React and optional features).
